result.question: Compare the net income of Apple and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer: In their most recent fiscal years, Nvidia's net income was higher than Apple's. Apple reported net income of $112,010,000,000 (approximately $112.0 billion) for its fiscal year 2025, which ended on September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079]. Nvidia reported net income of $120,067,000,000 (approximately $120.1 billion) for its fiscal year 2026, which ended on January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021].
